description: Change part of an existing GDScript file by exact text replacement, without resending the whole file. Each edit's 'old' must match exactly once (including indentation; GDScript uses tabs) unless replace_all is set; edits apply in order. The result is compiled first; on errors or a non-matching edit nothing is written. Returns a unified diff. Undoable with edit_undo.

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate and describe the change without applying it.

old.description: Exact text to replace (copy it from script_read).

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match.

path.description: res:// path of an existing .gd file.

name: script_edit
title: Edit script
